name: Proshchaniye
source:
Semyon has learned to return to Sovyonok whenever he wishes. But one day, he finds the camp deserted. What happened and where everyone went is exactly what our protagonist has to find out.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1821262284]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗已经学会了随时返回索维诺克。但有一天，他发现营地空无一人。发生了什么以及每个人去了哪里正是我们的主角必须找出的。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1821262284]Steam[/url]]
